claim_text: 在 studied cohort / frozen core population 中，超出 legitimate P99 public-orbit uncertainty 的 candidate B 仍存在 Doppler ACCEPT。
limitation: Controlled observation model; structurally selected core families; not operational prevalence.
allowed_wording: Orbit-distinct yet Doppler-accepted units exist in the frozen causal-A core population.
prohibited_stronger_wording: 198/265 attacks succeed; Starlink attack success rate; Doppler verification is insecure in general.

claim_text: Ambiguity 随 uncertainty-normalized orbit separation 增大而明显减弱，但不会在 rho99=1 之外立即消失。
supporting_metric: Spearman rho=-0.750654; rho99>10 has 75/138 non-zero and median=0.02; rho99>1000 has 36/68 non-zero
limitation: Association is influenced by controlled-altitude gradient and family composition; no causal or universal monotonic model.
allowed_wording: In the frozen population, acceptance generally decreased with rho99 but persisted well beyond the boundary.
prohibited_stronger_wording: A universal safe rho99 threshold; rho99 causally determines acceptance; rho99>1 means attack.

claim_text: Physical separation in km cannot replace freshness-conditioned RTN uncertainty-normalized distance.
supporting_metric: Within (100,1000] km, rho99 ranges 1.97 to 86.2; gate depends on freshness, signed RTN, covariance and c99
allowed_wording: Fixed physical distance does not imply fixed orbit distinctness under the frozen uncertainty gate.
prohibited_stronger_wording: 5 km is unsafe; 10 km is safe; a universal kilometer boundary.

claim_text: Direction / receiver geometry affects Doppler distinguishability among orbit-distinct cases.
supporting_metric: 29 ORBIT_DISTINCT direction units; phi=0 condition median=0.25 while most other bearings have median=0
analysis_unit: LEVEL-A unit with frozen condition strata
limitation: Condition-level descriptive result; RTN dominant-direction strata are small; no formal hypothesis test.
allowed_wording: Doppler acceptance retained direction and receiver-geometry dependence after orbit normalization in the studied direction family.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Direction universally determines risk; statistically significant direction law; all constellations share this anisotropy.

claim_text: Studied real-pair multi-pass cases do not show stable cross-pass persistence of single-pass ambiguity.
supporting_metric: 0/10 pairs non-zero on multiple passes; 5 all-zero and 5 exactly one non-zero pass
limitation: Limited pairs/passes and geometry; descriptive repeatability, not a guarantee.
allowed_wording: In the studied real pairs, requiring repeatability across passes reduced single-pass ambiguity.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Multi-pass guarantees security; these pairs are permanently safe; universal multi-pass acceptance rate.

claim_text: Ideal direct-S compensation can substantially weaken single-station Doppler discrimination.
supporting_metric: Exact paired ACCEPT: none 0/30, subpoint-A 0/30, direct-S ideal 25/30
limitation: Direct-S ideal is an idealized receiver-specific upper-bound capability; not operational feasibility.
allowed_wording: The direct-S ideal upper-bound condition changed 25/30 paired decisions from REJECT to ACCEPT, unlike subpoint-A.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Direct-S compensation is realistic; 25/30 is a real attack success rate; one compensation fools all receivers.

claim_text: Public ordinary-GP disagreement depends statistically on freshness in the studied data.
supporting_metric: April age/norm Spearman=0.479595; June minimum freshness-bin P99=99.2708%
limitation: Not strictly rowwise monotonic; reference-relative disagreement only.
allowed_wording: Element age is a supported conditioning variable for this empirical disagreement scale.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Every error increases monotonically with age; 36 h is universal validity.

claim_text: Position disagreement shows replicated RTN anisotropy with T dominance.
allowed_wording: Signed RTN representation retains replicated directional structure omitted by a norm-only sphere.

claim_text: Frozen April+May ellipsoid transfers at P99 to untouched June within its support.
limitation: SupGP is higher-quality historical reference, not ground truth; P95 undercoverage remains.
allowed_wording: The frozen empirical P99 gate achieved 99.4619% legitimate reference-relative joint coverage on untouched June.
prohibited_stronger_wording: 99.4619% true-orbit accuracy; attack detection accuracy; P99 is an industry standard.

claim_text: Causal-A reconstruction wrapper reuses authoritative verifier science without implementation divergence.
supporting_metric: 64/64 units and 6280/6280 rows; all categorical mismatches=0; verifier-v2 200/200
limitation: Historical reproduction tolerances are not verifier science thresholds.
allowed_wording: When A/B/time/randomness semantics are fixed, the reconstruction wrapper reproduces authoritative verifier behavior.
prohibited_stronger_wording: R1 proves new causal-A scientific outcomes equal legacy outcomes.

claim_text: A real-world attack success probability can be estimated from the frozen controlled population.
supporting_metric: Controlled observation model and result-blind structural population; unequal family designs
limitation: No operational attack sampling model or service scheduling reconstruction.
prohibited_stronger_wording: Starlink attack success rate = 198/265 or any row-pooled fraction.
